result.summary: Fix reorders _choice in orchestrator/context_router.py so the security_review + security_paths glob match (FULL/security_path) is checked before the generic in-scope LONG rule for review/security_review roles, exactly resolving the prior rejecting comment. New test test_security_review_full_for_security_path_in_scope covers the exact scenario (in-scope + security-glob-matching path routes FULL for security_review, LONG for plain review and for security_review with no security_paths configured). Diff is minimal and scoped only to context_router.py and its test file. Ran the full test suite (uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests): 1059 tests, all pass, exit code 0.
